donor: The Open Group Sensor Open Systems Architecture (SOSA), not W3C SOSA/SSN

source.title: Technical Standard for SOSA Reference Architecture
source.source_scope: §2.1.1–2.1.2, §4.1–4.1.1.4, §5.1–5.3 and selected Appendix A original definitions; only source text pages needed for these topics, not full 403-page audit
source.illustrations: Figure 4.1-1 original image inspected; Figure 5.1-1 and Figure 4.1-2 source text/figure context read but no independent high-resolution visual check claimed

source_records.locator: §4.1.1.1, printed p.21 / PDF p.47; App. A 'Sensor', printed p.362 / PDF p.388
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Bounded sensing system with one or more hardware elements, potentially containing software; described SOSA sensor modalities include communications, EO/IR, EW, radar and SIGINT.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Not identical to every generic CSAPI System, SensorML PhysicalSystem or installed individual sensor; no mandatory DIM superclass.

source_records.locator: §4.1.1.2, printed p.21 / PDF p.47; App. A 'Hardware Element', printed p.359 / PDF p.385
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Physical element of the SOSA sensor, possibly distributed on or in its host and capable of containing software or firmware; aperture and enclosure examples.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Physical SOSA hardware excludes purely logical modules; a reference design does not prove actual assembled inventory.

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Physical entity supporting/mounting a SOSA sensor; may be vehicle, structure, pod or combination and may provide power, cooling, navigation, time, signals and communications.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Host platform is not necessarily one probe's surveyed point, observation performer, platform owner or software runtime.

source_records.locator: §4.1.1.4, printed p.22 / PDF p.48; Figure 4.1-2, printed p.21 / PDF p.47; App. A 'Pod', printed p.361 / PDF p.387
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Pod delivered as integral part of a sensor and carrying elements from one or more SOSA sensors; separate figure illustrates a pod-on-platform special case.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Not every pod is merely an external host; integral-to-sensor and physical hosting can overlap by configuration.

source_records.locator: §4.1, printed p.20 / PDF p.46; Figure 4.1-1
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Interface crossing SOSA sensor boundary, including the sensing aperture's environment-facing role and host-facing interfaces.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Boundary crossing alone does not prove an external instrument, physical probe cable, CSAPI connection or data endpoint.

source_records.locator: §4.1, printed p.20 / PDF p.46; Figure 4.1-1
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Physical/context interface contained within the SOSA sensor boundary; other SOSA views address logical message relationships.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Internal interface is not synonymous with physically attached component, containment hierarchy or network-visible node.

source_records.locator: §5.1, printed p.29 / PDF p.55; Figure 5.1-1
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Umbrella for logical modules implementing functions and infrastructure supporting their implementation, with possible hardware, firmware and software realizations.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: The word component is not sufficient to assert physical part-of, an equipment individual or a universal DIM class root.

source_records.locator: §§5.1–5.3, printed pp.29–32 / PDF pp.55–58; App. A 'Module', printed p.360 / PDF p.386
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Logical architectural building block specifying functional behavior and interfaces, with implementation through hardware or software infrastructure; designed for independent replaceability.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: One logical module need not be one physical device, one purchased unit, one runtime process or an independent observer.

source_records.locator: §5.1, printed pp.29–30 / PDF pp.55–56; Figure 5.1-1
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Architecture support grouped as hardware elements, software runtime environments and interaction infrastructure.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Three distinct support categories are not one physical chassis, not automatically a site, and not necessarily one procured element.

source_records.locator: §§4.1.1.2,5.1, printed pp.21,29–30 / PDF pp.47,55–56; App. A 'Plug-In Card', printed p.361 / PDF p.387
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Hardware card with a backplane interface; SOSA-specific PIC conforms to a defined SOSA slot profile.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Card count is not count of sensors or functional modules; PIC profile does not apply to every environmental instrument.

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Hardware element examples include electromagnetic aperture, chassis/enclosure and power-supply infrastructure.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: An enclosure or backplane is not the mandatory root of a sensing System, and the source makes no claim that all sensing equipment must use SOSA chassis.

source_records.locator: §5.1, printed p.30 / PDF p.56; Figure 5.1-1
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Execution support for SOSA software through operating-system processes, container engines or hypervisors.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: A software execution environment is not the vehicle/structure SOSA Host Platform or a physical constituent by itself.

source_records.locator: §5.1, printed p.30 / PDF p.56; App. A 'Interaction' / 'Interface', printed p.360 / PDF p.386
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Supporting communication mechanisms with transport APIs and interaction bindings; modules exchange data/signals across defined interfaces.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: An interface or message transport is not physical attachment, a probe connector, completed observation or CSAPI data binding.

source_records.locator: §5.3, printed pp.31–32 / PDF pp.57–58
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Implementation/procurement grouping that can combine any suitable number of logical modules and infrastructure elements while meeting interface boundary requirements.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Taxonomy explicitly stops short of defining purchasing/implementation patterns; a procured product does not imply one module, component, sensor or product-model identifier.

source_records.locator: App. A 'Platform', printed p.361 / PDF p.387
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Term changes meaning with context among device/sensing environment, physical vehicle/host and computing infrastructure; source requires qualifying context.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Unqualified Platform is ambiguous; never infer it specifically means host vehicle, physical station or W3C sosa:Platform.

source_records.locator: App. A 'System' / 'Subsystem', printed p.363 / PDF p.389
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: System is cooperating group of elements producing useful capability; one system can be a subsystem relative to another.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Generic system nesting does not identify particular manufactured sensor instance or prove that all containment is physical.

source_records.locator: App. A 'Element', printed p.359 / PDF p.385
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Basic hardware, software or logical constituent of a system or subsystem.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Generic element is broader than physical hardware, and not automatically a distinct equipment unit.

source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Sensor may belong to communications, EO/IR, EW, radar or SIGINT categories or combinations; scope of this SOSA architecture.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Modality category is not count of actual instruments, inferred observation properties or an imposed DIM classification hierarchy.

source_records.term: SOSA Rule / Recommendation / Permission / description standing
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Rules are mandatory for conformance where explicitly designated; Recommendations, Permissions and descriptive text have different standing.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Descriptive definitions/figures read here are not transformed into invented blanket SHALLs; no conformance testing is performed.

source_records.term: Sensor physical mounting versus logical relations
source_records.locator: §4.1 and Figures 4.1-1/4.1-2, printed pp.20–21 / PDF pp.46–47
source_records.original_meaning_paraphrase: Physical views show sensor elements on host/pod and distinguish physical connections from cross-sensor logical relationships; rendered elements are exemplary and optional.
source_records.non_equivalence_limit: Physical drawing edges are not proof of actual case deployment, assigned probe coordinates, every member physically integrated or digital interface identity.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: SOSA Sensor contributes a specific sensor-system boundary and modality to the proposed described sensing arrangement.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Does not prove generic CSAPI System identity, ownership of deployed sensors or a mandatory domain superclass.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: Source's generic System/SubSystem concept permits hierarchical systems without fixing one sensing domain root.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Generic SOSA System is not always an instantiated physical sensing apparatus.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: A SOSA Hardware Element is physical and can be a sensor constituent, with source-defined configuration bounds.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Not every physical environmental probe or other equipment is a SOSA hardware element.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: PIC, aperture, chassis/enclosure and power supply are documented SOSA hardware/infrastructure examples.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: SOSA hardware architecture is not universal sensor hardware inventory or mandatory chassis hierarchy.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: SOSA Host Platform contributes concrete physical support/mounting context for a SOSA Sensor.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Does not establish source-specific geolocation, site operator, sensor's own geometry or a software host.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: SOSA Sensor Pod is an integral packaging and mounting case where sensor and pod boundaries overlap.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Cannot always treat pod as external hosting platform or as a physically separate sensor.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: SOSA External Interface crosses sensor boundary and may connect to host/environment.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Not equivalent to a distinct externally cabled ClimaVue, SDI-12 connector, or all connected equipment.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: Internal interfaces and drawn physical relationships provide relation/context evidence.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Interface presence does not entail strict part-of, one function per card or installed topology.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: SOSA Module is a separately defined functional architecture role that might be implemented on physical hardware.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: It must NOT be read as physical constituent by label or produce phantom hardware/part-of edges.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: SOSA Sensor Component and generic Element can include logical/software as well as physical realizations.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Cannot silently equate 'component' with physical module, installed probe or hardware individual.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: RTE describes execution hosting of software, not a physical vehicle/structure.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Do not use unqualified platform/host terms to infer location or physical attachment.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: Interaction infrastructure carries logical information exchange between modules.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Transport/binding cannot prove a distinct network-visible node, physical cable or original measurement author.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: A procurable unit may implement multiple modules/physical infrastructure elements.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Purchase unit or product type is not identical to one module, one model designation, one installed asset or one sensor.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: Source's unqualified 'Platform' can describe sensor device, physical host or computing infrastructure.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Only qualified 'SOSA Host Platform' has defensible physical host interpretation.

scoped_correspondence.source_first_correspondence: SOSA function/interface decomposition is not ISA CIC visible/opaque member exposure.
scoped_correspondence.non_equivalence_warning: Do not import ISA network member/virtual UCI semantics into SOSA without exact SOSA source evidence.

held_source_leads.topic: Logical functional Module as candidate DIM functionality/role
held_source_leads.reason: No existing cross-donor row unambiguously represents functional module role distinct from physical component; consider when later donors support coherent meaning.

held_source_leads.topic: Infrastructure split into hardware, run-time and interaction support
held_source_leads.reason: Architecture grouping is useful but does not justify one universal three-part DIM superclass.

held_source_leads.topic: Sensor pod as integral package versus separate host
held_source_leads.reason: Physical mounting/part-of semantics depend on arrangement; source case installation status must remain independent.

held_source_leads.topic: SOSA module implementation cardinality and procurement units
held_source_leads.reason: No one-module-to-one-physical-element/procurable-unit cardinality; owner-relevant DIM physical versus functional distinction.
Context must disambiguate device/vehicle/software computing platform before mapping.

held_source_leads.topic: Native DSDM, management OpenAPI and future snapshots
held_source_leads.reason: C239 narrative does not itself prove exact DSDM native classes or 2025 S251 edition claims; separate source review later.
